verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only per-item API operations: create, update, lock or delete a single card, and list or filter transactions. It shows no batch or bulk endpoint, bulk card issuance, or mass-update capability. Pulling all transactions for a billing period (clara-docs-12) is list retrieval, and looping over single-item endpoints is a developer building block, so neither counts as the product's own bulk-operation capability.
